full.description: This image is a photomicrograph of a blood vessel, likely a saphenous vein graft, stained to highlight structural changes. The tissue shows marked thickening of the wall and fibrotic remodeling. These features are characteristic of saphenous vein graft sclerosis, a form of cardiovascular vascular disease. The histological section reveals extensive collagen deposition and cellular proliferation within the vessel wall.
